PyYAML 6.0.2, vendored from the official source distribution on PyPI.

Only the pure Python `lib/yaml` package is included; no platform extension or
runtime installation is needed. See LICENSE for the MIT license. Source:
https://pypi.org/project/PyYAML/6.0.2/

Motion lists use a SafeLoader subclass that rejects duplicate keys. Do not
replace it with an unrestricted YAML loader.
